name: QML-Health-READY
description: Benchmark code (benchmark_colab_v3.py), manuscript builder and the per-split results reported in the manuscript. Every number in the manuscript is regenerated from results/benchmark_results.json by build_manuscript.py. Data are public and downloaded by the scripts; no patient data are included. Earlier, superseded pipelines are kept in legacy_v1/ and legacy_v2/ for transparency.
